apps.name: AthleteOS Recorder
apps.localizedDescription: Raw Polar H10 overnight recorder. AthleteOS performs all analysis and coaching.

versions.localizedDescription: Fixes retained-night recovery ordering: reconnects and establishes PS-FTP first, then verifies single-BLE mode, preventing SDK error 2/3 while disconnected before retrying the retained RR fetch. Keeps the H10 sensor copy until AthleteOS verifies upload.
